correctness.rationale: On the probability-normalized complex unit sphere of C³, the fourth-moment identity gives ||zᵀMz||²_2=tr(MM*)/6 for symmetric M. Takagi factorization gives ||zᵀMz||∞=||M||op; for unit L² this is at least sqrt(tr(MM*)/3)=sqrt2, with equality exactly for M=sqrt2 times symmetric unitary. The six real unit axes from antipodal vertices of an icosahedron have exact pairwise squared overlap 1/5. With ξ=(-7+i√15)/8, |ξ|=1 and Re ξ=-7/8, U_v=I+(ξ-1)vvᵀ are symmetric unitaries and tr(U_v U_w*)=0 for v!=w since 3+2(Re ξ-1)+(2-2Re ξ)/5=0; diagonal Gram trace 3. Their six quadratic forms form a complete orthonormal basis and every member attains sqrt2. An independent exact symbolic golden-ratio overlap check and the package finite numerical checker corroborate the explicit matrices; the universal lower bound is analytic.
